entries.name: Sandstorm

description.from: Create a Sandstorm at target foe's location. For 10 seconds, nearby foes are struck for 10...30 earth damage each second and attacking foes are struck for an additional 10...30 earth damage each second.

concise.to: Deals 20...40 earth damage each second (10 seconds). Hits foes near target foe's initial location. Hits attacking foes for 10...30 more earth damage each second.

description.to: Target touched foe takes 40...100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.

concise.to: Deals 40...100 damage. <gray>You are Dazed (10 seconds).</gray>

description.to: For 1...7 seconds, you have a 30...60% chance to block incoming attacks. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 earth damage.

concise.to: (1...7 seconds.) You have 30...60% chance to block. Initial Effect: deals 10...40 earth damage to nearby foes.

entries.name: Fleeting Stability

description.from: For 2...6 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.
description.to: For 4...10 seconds, you cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. This enchantment ends prematurely if it prevents a knockdown.

concise.to: (4...10 seconds.) You cannot be knocked down and move 25% faster. Ends if knockdown prevented.

description.to: For 1...6 seconds, you move 33% faster than normal. The next time you strike a foe, all other nearby foes take 10...50 cold damage and this enchantment ends.

concise.to: (1...6 seconds.) You move 33% faster. Deal 10...50 cold damage to all other nearby foes the next time you hit a foe and this enchantment ends.

description.to: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5...20 seconds.

concise.to: Deals +10...50 damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition (5...20 seconds) if target is not moving.

description.to: If this attack hits, you deal +10...50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4...10 seconds.

concise.to: (30 seconds.) Deals 16...50 damage to foes in place of other damage or effects from melee attacks. <gray>Your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit.</gray>
